categories.name: Ackerman OS · Trust and continuity
categories.tagline: One family conversation, with clear ownership and recovery.

categories.name: Ackerman OS · Portable play
categories.tagline: Small experiences that travel between screens.

ideas.title: Encrypted offline outbox
ideas.pitch: Write now; send once a trusted connection returns.
ideas.experience: A watch or Deck holds a reply through a tunnel or dead zone and sends it once, with the same turn ID.
ideas.how: Encrypt per-device pending turns, preserve idempotency and reconcile accepted receipts on reconnect.
ideas.risks: Replay protection, storage wear and a lost-key recovery path need hardware tests.
ideas.audience: Families moving between Wi-Fi and radio

ideas.title: Family permissions that are visible
ideas.pitch: Give a parent clear control over device enrollment and access.
ideas.experience: The parent can see which devices may join the family thread and revoke one without re-enrolling everything.
ideas.how: Add scoped device grants, revocation receipts and a read-only family dashboard.
ideas.risks: Do not expose a parent credential to the child device or public site.
ideas.audience: Parents managing watches, decks and tablets

ideas.title: What works, shown honestly
ideas.pitch: Show sync, voice and radio state on every screen.
ideas.experience: A message says waiting, sent, answered or needs attention; there is no mystery spinner.
ideas.how: Share a small state machine in Nelua and render it for each canvas.
ideas.risks: A network timeout can leave an accepted turn; status must reconcile rather than duplicate it.

ideas.title: Portable Lua app kit
ideas.pitch: Make one safe app run on watch, Deck and Android.
ideas.experience: A small game can use buttons, notes and a bounded canvas without three rewrites.
ideas.how: Publish versioned app capabilities, a simulator and packaging checks around the shared Lua runtime.
ideas.risks: Memory, display shape and permissions differ across devices.
ideas.audience: Makers building family apps and games

ideas.title: Continue a game on another device
ideas.pitch: Carry an optional game checkpoint between companions.
ideas.experience: Start a trail on the watch and finish its next choice on the tablet.
ideas.how: Sync explicit versioned app checkpoints through the family service with per-app consent.
ideas.risks: Offline conflicts and private note data need strict separation.
